verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Braintrust exposing its own MCP server so that external clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code) can query Braintrust — the reverse of the story, which asks whether Braintrust itself can consume external MCP servers' tools. No evidence shows Braintrust or its Loop agent acting as an MCP client to plug in and use third-party MCP servers.
